# Rugby Campus

> A free guide to US men's college rugby programs for aspiring players: CRAA D1A and NCR D1 programs, mapped and tiered, with coach emails (free with an email signup) and plain-English recruitment guides. Built by Hugh Johnston, an Australian who played, captained and then coached Notre Dame College to the 2023 NCR D1 National Championship.

Rugby Campus is independent. It is not affiliated with USA Rugby, CRAA or NCR. It covers men's programs only; women's programs are not listed yet. Men's rugby is not an NCAA sport anywhere (the NCAA lists varsity women's rugby as an Emerging Sport for Women).

How the site makes money: free for players. Revenue comes from paid one-on-one coaching, and colleges may pay for a featured listing, which is always labelled Featured. Program profiles, tiers, the map and the guides are open to everyone; coach email addresses are shown after a free one-time email signup.

- [All men's programs, tiered](https://www.rugbycampus.org/colleges): Tier 1 (strongest) to Tier 4
- [Interactive map](https://www.rugbycampus.org/map)

- [Why college rugby rankings lie](https://www.rugbycampus.org/learn/why-college-rugby-rankings-lie)
- [When college rugby programs die](https://www.rugbycampus.org/learn/when-college-rugby-programs-die)
- [How to play rugby in college in the USA](https://www.rugbycampus.org/learn/how-to-play-rugby-college-usa)
- [Rugby scholarships in the USA explained](https://www.rugbycampus.org/learn/rugby-scholarships-explained)
- [How college rugby recruitment works](https://www.rugbycampus.org/learn/how-college-rugby-recruitment-works)

- [About Hugh](https://www.rugbycampus.org/about)
- [For college coaches](https://www.rugbycampus.org/for-coaches)
- [Privacy](https://www.rugbycampus.org/privacy)

## Full data
- [llms-full.txt](https://www.rugbycampus.org/llms-full.txt): every program with affiliation, conference, squad size, and MLR draft and playing numbers (drafted and played are counted separately)
- [sitemap.xml](https://www.rugbycampus.org/sitemap.xml)
